notes.title: 2nd Major Update – December 2025
notes.notes:
Hello! First of all, I’d like to sincerely thank everyone for the support since the game’s release on 06/19/2025. Your encouragement really motivates me to keep working on the project.



I’m very grateful for all the suggestions, improvement ideas, and bug reports. I’m sure that with the community’s help, the game is getting better and better!



I’m very excited to announce the date of the next major update. I can’t reveal too many details yet, but I can already say it will include some highly requested features, such as a map system to make exploration easier.



Please take this opportunity to suggest improvements you find interesting — I’ll carefully review them, and who knows, some might make it into the game.



In the coming months, I hope to share more details about this major update. From the bottom of my heart, I hope you’ll enjoy it and keep having fun with Sunshine Farm!

notes.title: Patch #4 – Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Bugs Fixed
Bug Fixed – The selected item wouldn't stay in the correct chest slot when using a controller.

Bug Fixed – Pineapple crops were missing the wind effect.

Bug Fixed – Frost Skeleton sprite fixed when defending.

Bug Fixed – It was impossible to place a tile below the wall if the Small or Large Bookshelf was full.

Bug Fixed – Placing tea on the shelf would make it lose its sprite and not appear in the selling list, making it impossible to sell teas.

Bug Fixed – The dryer now correctly displays the item it's producing.



Thank you all for the feedback! Feel free to keep reporting bugs and sharing suggestions.

notes.title: Big Update! Controller support and many improvements - v1.1
notes.notes:
Improvements
Xbox controller support added

Some simple dialogue lines added for the fair NPCs

Now, when completing a request on the farm board, an NPC is created and walks to the board to “collect the item”

Minor improvements to dungeon scenery

New Objects:

3 new Flower Pots, sold at the flower shop

3 Wall Planters, sold at the flower shop

2 Boxed Plants, sold at the flower shop

9 Wall Paintings, sold at the furniture store

To help new players, on Day 1 the player now receives a letter with instructions for the first steps

Players now receive Aurins (coins) for completing the initial tutorials

When hitting a thief who stole items from the shop, they will drop the stolen items on the ground, allowing recovery

A break room was added for employees when they have nothing to do

When a stocker goes to refill a display, they now automatically organize it; the higher their level, the faster they do it
Balancing
The game now starts with 100 Aurins (coins)

Weapon and tool durability increased by 100 points

Reduced cost of weapons and tools:

Stone: −50

Sword: 150 > 100

Tools: 100 > 50

Copper: −200

Sword: 700 > 500

Tools: 500 > 300

Iron: −500

Sword: 2,000 > 1,500

Tools: 1,500 > 1,000

Steel: −500

Sword: 3,500 > 3,000

Tools: 3,000 > 2,500

Reduced cost of armor:

Leather: −50 (200 > 150)

Copper: −500 (1,000 > 500)

Iron: −1,100 (2,600 > 1,500)

Steel: −1,000 (4,000 > 3,000)

Hay feed cost reduced: 15 > 10

Buying or crafting feed now gives 3 items instead of 2

Crops now only have a chance of being destroyed under the following conditions:

Storms, very strong winds, or heavy snowstorms

Debt is now deducted at a fixed daily rate of 100 Aurins, regardless of how much money the player has

Previously, the more money the player had, the higher the deduction

Adjustments to animal mood loss

Many object prices reduced

Shop purchase price reduced: 10,000 > 5,000
UI Adjustments
Resolution now adjusts for ultra-wide monitors in fullscreen

Shop time speed icon was in the wrong position

Object sizes adjusted in the woodworking bench interface
Bugs
Fixed – Buying feed didn’t give the correct amount shown in the interface

Fixed – The shop warehouse interface now correctly displays item descriptions

Fixed – Sometimes the store employee would get stuck when trying to store an item

Fixed – When building a distiller and picking it up again, it turned into a Mill

Other minor bugs
Crash
Fixed – Opening the active mission list caused the game to crash

notes.title: Big Update - 08/04/25
notes.notes:
Big Update - August 4, 2025


This update will be bigger than the previous ones, so I’ll be adding some requested features. Please hang in there a little longer. Below is a list of some of the main features coming in this update:

Support for Xbox and compatible controllers (XInput)

Simple dialogues with NPCs walking around the fair

New NPC variations

Some improvements to the dungeon atmosphere

New objects

Thanks to everyone for the feedback! Feel free to keep reporting bugs and sending suggestions.

Bugs
Fixed Bug – Barn or chicken coop was stacking more than 99 feed.

Fixed Bug – Barn and chicken coop were stacking more than 99 eggs.

Fixed Bug – Opening the shop while in build mode would cause time speed to alternate between 1 and 3.

Fixed Bug – Collisions from the guild tent and potion tent remained even after the adventurers' guild and potion shop were built.

Fixed Bug – The chicken's HP bar wasn't showing.
Crash Fixes
Fixed Crash – When trying to place a cash register outside the shop.

Fixed Crash – Sometimes starting a new game would freeze due to the idle animation toggle added in Patch #2.
Currently Working On
Xbox and DualSense (PS5) controller support.

Simple dialogue with NPCs who walk around the map.

Feel free to share your suggestions for what you'd like to see in the game :)



Thanks to everyone for the feedback—keep reporting bugs and sharing ideas!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.0.1 (Improvements and bug fixes)
notes.notes:
New Features
- Xbox controller support is now working from this version onward
- When a tool breaks, if you have another in your inventory, it now automatically replaces the broken tool without needing to open the inventory and place it in the hotbar

Balancing
- Small increase in dash duration

Bugs Fixed
- When passing midnight in the dungeon and returning to the world, it wouldn't get dark even though it was still night
- The arrow can now also be deflected with a sword or scythe attack

Thank you all for the feedback! Feel free to give suggestions and let me know any bugs you’ve found!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.7.0 (Improvements, gameplay changes, and bug fixes)
notes.notes:
Major Improvements

Character Customization is coming! In the final game, players will be able to create their own clothes, set up a clothing store, and even craft armor.

Dungeon with 15 floors. In the final game, it will go up to floor 100.

Adventurers' Guild. For now, players can complete some requests at the guild, but more extensive missions will be added.

Potion Shop. Players can now buy potions, and in the full game, they will be able to craft their own and open a potion shop.

Intro Cutscene. The first cutscene of the game is complete, though it may still change before the final version.

Slightly changed the starting area of the world.

The debt system will no longer have interest; instead, a fixed amount will be deducted from the player's account daily.

A new monster has also been added.

New Features
- Grass now has a chance to drop an item: fibers.

- Grasses with flowers can drop a flower.

- The flowers in the environment also have a chance to drop flowers when cut.


Sounds
- Exclusive music for the dungeon
- Skeleton sounds

Bugs Fixed
- Various bugs fixed and small polish updates.

Save
Saves from the version prior to 0.2.0.0 will not work in this new version (0.2.0.0). I added many systems and several new features in this version, I hope you understand.

Thank you all for the feedback! Feel free to give suggestions and let me know any bugs you’ve found!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.7.0 (Improvements, gameplay changes, and bug fixes)
notes.notes:
Major Improvements
- The hitbox now moves according to the mouse position, making it easier to collect resources.
- Stamina and item durability now only decrease if the player actually lands a hit; otherwise, they won’t 
  decrease.
- The hitbox will turn red if the player fails to land a hit.
- It’s now possible to harvest simply by pressing "E" when colliding with the plant.


New Features
- The hotbar is now numbered, and it's also possible to select an item by clicking on the hotbar slot.
- The order board now displays an icon whenever there is a new order.
- The current money is now also shown in the item selling interface and order board.
- The financial interface now displays the amount that will be deducted from the player to pay the debt 
   for the day.
- Some general UI improvements.

Balancing
- Stone equipment durability decreased: 500 > 400.
- Stone equipment price increased: 30 > 50.
- Stone sword damage decreased: 3 > 2.

Sounds
- A sound effect now plays when breaking a barrel.

Bugs Fixed
- When reaching the harvest stage, if a day passed, the crop would return to the seed stage.
- Some collisions in the wrong position.
- Slime has an animation and walking effect even when standing still.
- The item quantity displayed on the bridge HUD would reset every time a save was loaded or when 
   leaving and re-entering the area, but the items remained there.
- And a few other minor bugs...



Thank you all for the feedback! Feel free to give suggestions and let me know any bugs you’ve found!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.6.0 (Bug Fixes, Improvements and Current Work)
notes.notes:
Additions
- When fainting or dying, a text now appears explaining what happened
- Whenever it hits midnight, a notification appears reminding the player to go to sleep
- Music changed! Now the game has the correct music for the spring season

Bugs Fixes
- Wild boar attacking even when changing scenario
- Player tilted when changing scenario while performing a dash
- Some collisions adjusted
- Fixed some texts missing translations to English and German


Crash Fixes
- When starting a new game for the first time, there was a chance the game would freeze

What am I currently working on?
- I’ve been working on the first 20 floors of the mine!
- I started creating the character customization system.
- Some of you asked to improve the hitbox control, I’ll start working on that soon!

Thank you all for the feedback! Feel free to suggest anything and let me know about any bugs you’ve found!
